content:
Import a manuscript and watch characters, props, sets, and state memory resolve into linked canon.

Story Room

Move from canon to drafting to visual canon without rebuilding prompts every time a scene changes.

Why teams switch

AxiomStory is designed for the moment when a world becomes too large for notes, folders, and prompt snippets to hold together.

Notes, prompts, image folders, and drafts drift apart fast. AxiomStory gives the room a single source of truth.

Instead of rebuilding prompts scene by scene, AxiomStory composes context from canon records, continuity context, and relevant passages.

Keep generated visuals tied to the entries, events, and prompt history that made them canonical.

What the room gets

Start the universe, let the product resolve context, and keep moving between manuscripts, continuity review, and visual canon without rebuilding the same understanding.
